name: The Absent Minded Prospector
summary: In southern Darkshore, hostile stone golems overrun a dig site, and Archaeologist Hollee seeks help in Auberdine. She fears for Prospector Remtravel, her senior colleague, whose research often blinds him to mortal danger.

sections.title: A Perilous Dig
sections.body: Archaeologist Hollee crossed the sea with the Explorers' League, sent by Master Greywhisker to apprentice under Prospector Remtravel. His discoveries had made him renowned in Ironforge's academic circles. The League sent him to study ancient ruins along Darkshore's untamed coast. As the pair excavated what seemed to be the remains of a great civilization, violent stone golems burst from the earth and overran the site.

sections.title: Oblivious to Doom
sections.body: Hollee fled in panic through the night to Auberdine, the night elf port, to seek help. Remtravel barely noticed the danger. Absorbed in the relics he had uncovered, the elderly prospector stayed among the rubble while lumbering constructs surrounded his camp. South of Auberdine, anyone who reaches him finds him grumbling about missing stone brushes and misplaced fossils.

faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is a celebrated dwarven researcher with the Explorers' League of Ironforge. His groundbreaking discoveries made him famous in dwarven academic circles, but valuable relics can leave him unaware of danger around him.

faq.q: Why is Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Master Greywhisker assigned Hollee to assist Remtravel. When dangerous golems emerged at their dig site, she fled north in panic to Auberdine for help with a rescue.

faq.q: What were the dwarves excavating in Darkshore?
faq.answer: The dwarves were excavating what appeared to be the remains of an ancient, great civilization beneath Darkshore. Remtravel had uncovered a mysterious fossil and stone artifacts before golems overran the site.

faq.q: Where can Prospector Remtravel be found?
faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is at the excavation site in southern Darkshore, among ancient ruins south of Auberdine. Dangerous golems surround his camp as he searches for his stone brush and fossil.

faq.q: Who sent this expedition to Darkshore?
faq.answer: The Explorers' League sent the expedition from Ironforge under Master Greywhisker's orders. Greywhisker assigned Hollee to apprentice under Remtravel and study Darkshore's ancient ruins.
Yes. Hostile golems prowl the ruins around him, but Remtravel is oblivious to the danger. He is focused on cataloging his findings and wonders where his tools and assistant have wandered off to.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Remtravel's obsessive curiosity at work: he risks limb and life over an uncatalogued fossil.
As an Alliance traveler, you see Ironforge researchers studying the unfamiliar ancient lands of their night elf allies in Kalimdor.
